name: Cyclic Face Interpolant (Blue Path)
definition: An interpolant for Marching Squares cells where vertices are swept in cyclic order around the face (path 8 to 11). It involves non-polynomial behavior due to edge points moving on opposite edges.
summary: The Cyclic Face Interpolant resolves Marching Squares topology ambiguity by sweeping vertices cyclically, producing a continuous but non-polynomial surface that differs from the Red Path interpolant.
